title: OwedInput
description: Something only an outside party can give, recorded by a reviewer or an evidence requirement (docs/design/m0/04 "Owed inputs"). The dependent work holds on awaiting_input. A ruling or data input is answered by an input.answer approval binding its revision; a receipt input is satisfied only by an applicable receipt, never by a ruling.

revision.description: The owed input's revision; an answer binds it, so a changed question needs a new answer.
